scores.reasons: Nearly everything is missing or broken - stale 2019 Wix site, broken mobile layout, PDF intake, no booking, almost no reviews; a single-dentist practice with a 1.0/3-review footprint suggests limited budget and little marketing spend; the fixes themselves are simple, well-understood work; all evidence gathered from the live site.

caveats: Ratings and review counts came from directory aggregators (Birdeye, Zocdoc, WebMD, Healthgrades, dentistsranked, localitybiz) and practices' own review widgets - not from Google Business Profiles directly, so counts may differ from what Google shows today.

Agent-readiness notes for KK Dental, Hidden Lake, Tauk, Brunswick Regional and North Brunswick Dental Group do not include a robots.txt check; only North Brunswick Family Dental, Delicate Dental, Brilliant Smiles and Dr. Ziemba had robots.txt opened.
